description: GPU memory, number of GPUs, speed and rental cost to run an open LLM. Works for the models listed at https://studiotvai.com/api/models.json and any Hugging Face model id or link. Uses the real KV cache of each architecture (sliding window, hybrid linear attention, MLA).

concurrent_requests.description: Requests served at the same time, each with its own KV cache. Default 1.

engine.description: Serving engine. Default: vllm on data-center GPUs, llamacpp elsewhere (Macs included; mlx is Apple's engine, often faster there, with its own mlx_* weight formats).

gpu.description: GPU id or name, e.g. "rtx-4090", "H100", "mac-m4-max-128", or "cpu" for a machine without graphics card. Default h100. List: https://studiotvai.com/api/gpus.json

gpu_count.description: Number of GPUs, or "auto" (default) for the fewest that fit. For a Mac, a DGX Spark or a Ryzen AI Max machine: the number of machines in a cluster (8 at most).

kv_cache.description: KV cache precision. Default bf16. nvfp4: vLLM only, NVIDIA GPUs, models with standard attention (otherwise bf16 is used).

model.description: Model name or id ("Llama 3.3 70B", "qwen3.8-27b"), Hugging Face id ("Qwen/Qwen3-32B") or link.

system_ram_gb.description: System RAM in GB of a personal machine (gaming GPU with llama.cpp). When the model does not fit in GPU memory, estimate_vram then says whether it runs with part of it in RAM, and how fast. Needed with gpu "cpu" (no graphics card), where the whole model runs from RAM. Omit if unknown.

weights.description: Weight format. Default: the official checkpoint (native) or BF16.

name: estimate_vram
title: Does this LLM fit on this GPU?
